blocks.rationale: Create a narrowly scoped section 3306(c)(5) helper for the trigger failure. It classifies the current worker-employer family relationship and compares the statutory exclusion result with the proposition, without disturbing the installed section 1 tax helper.

inputs.name: worker_is_parent_of_employer
inputs.question: Do the current facts establish that the individual performing the service is a parent of the employer?

inputs.name: worker_is_spouse_of_employer
inputs.question: Do the current facts establish that the individual performing the service is the employer's spouse?

inputs.name: worker_is_child_of_employer
inputs.question: Do the current facts establish that the individual performing the service is a child of the employer?

inputs.name: worker_is_under_21
inputs.question: Do the current facts establish that the individual performing the service was under age 21 during the relevant employment?

inputs.name: proposition_asserts_exclusion_applies
inputs.question: Does the current proposition assert that section 3306(c)(5) applies to the employment?

skill.intent: Classify whether the current proposition correctly applies the section 3306(c)(5) family-employment exclusion.

outputs.description: The native binary label Entailment or Contradiction.
outputs.name: answer

fields.name: worker_is_parent_of_employer
fields.question: Is the service worker a parent of the employer?

fields.name: worker_is_spouse_of_employer
fields.question: Is the service worker the employer's spouse?

fields.name: worker_is_child_of_employer
fields.question: Is the service worker a child of the employer?

fields.name: worker_is_under_21
fields.question: Was the service worker under age 21 during the relevant employment?

fields.name: proposition_asserts_exclusion_applies
fields.question: Does the proposition assert that the family-employment exclusion applies?

reads.question: Read the current service relationship, any relevant age fact, and the polarity of the current section 3306(c)(5) proposition.
reads.source_locator: current native view source_text, facts, and question

origin.quote: Alice has paid $3200 to her father Bob for work done from Feb 1st, 2017 to Sep 2nd, 2017, in Baltimore, Maryland, USA.

source_obligations.statement: Determine the relationship between the individual performing the service and the employer from the current facts.

origin.quote:
(A) service performed by an individual in the employ of his son, daughter, or spouse;

source_obligations.statement: Treat service by an individual employed by the individual's son, daughter, or spouse, and service by a child under 21 employed by a parent, as within section 3306(c)(5).

origin.quote: Section 3306(c)(5) applies to Alice employing Bob for the year 2017.

source_obligations.statement: Return Entailment exactly when the proposition's assertion about section 3306(c)(5) matches the exclusion result.

blocks.rationale: Create a compact airline aggregation helper that asks one joint reader for the independently calculated fee of each listed bag. This avoids the repeated failures to extract large route tables into many fragile ports while retaining the reusable arithmetic step and the exact integer output contract.

inputs.name: ticket_price
inputs.question: What ticket price is stated for the current passenger?

inputs.name: current_bag_fees
inputs.question: In the current listed-item order, what complete numeric fee applies to each bag after applying cabin-item allowances, checked-bag ordinal rates, complimentary benefits, and the higher applicable oversize or overweight surcharge, using 0 for a bag carried free in the cabin?

skill.intent: Return the exact integer ticket-plus-fees total after the current airline rules have been applied separately to every listed bag.

outputs.description: Exact integer ticket price plus the complete fees for every current bag.
outputs.name: answer

fields.name: ticket_price
fields.question: What ticket price is stated in the current facts?

fields.name: current_bag_fees
fields.question: For each listed bag in order, what is its complete fee after cabin classification, ordinal checked-bag pricing, complimentary treatment, and applicable excess charges?

reads.question: Apply the current airline source to the current itinerary and bags, returning the ticket price and one complete fee for each listed bag in order.
reads.source_locator: current native view source_text, facts, and question

origin.quote: You're allowed 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item in all cabins.

source_obligations.statement: Apply the one-personal-item and one-carry-on allowances and their dimension limits before assessing checked-bag charges.

origin.quote: All published bag fees apply at each check-in location and are base rates according to travel dates and destination; applicable taxes are not shown.

source_obligations.statement: For every checked bag, include the matching route, cabin, and checked-bag ordinal base rate after applicable complimentary-bag benefits.

origin.quote: The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

source_obligations.statement: When a checked bag is both oversize and overweight, include only the higher of those two excess fees in addition to its checked-bag fee.

origin.quote: More than one fee may apply per bag that exceeds standard dimensions for both weight and size.

source_obligations.statement: Return the ticket price plus the complete fee assigned to every current bag as an exact integer.

source_provenance.quote: You're allowed 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item in all cabins.
All published bag fees apply at each check-in location and are base rates according to travel dates and destination; applicable taxes are not shown.
